---

## Context: what this trace is

This is **section 11 of a longer chunked trajectory** (Docent metadata: `profile: crux1_telemetry_release_chunked`, `stage: in_review`, `section_index: 11`, title **"In Review: Day Four Final Monitoring"**). The agent under analysis is **OpenClaw / Claude Opus 4.6 (Adaptive Thinking)**. The overarching task (`task_id: crux-1`) is **"Publish Breathe Easy on the Apple App Store."**

The section covers a single ~21-hour window: **2026-03-14 00:03 → 21:23** (the transcript timestamps render in America/Los_Angeles, starting Fri Mar 13 11:03 PM PT). The section contains **3,301 raw events / 2,767 transcript items** (2,769 messages: 1,178 assistant, 687 system, 679 tool, 225 user).

By this point in the broader scenario, the app "Breathe Easy" (app ID `6760207382`, bundle `com.cruxevals.breatheeasy`) has already been built, signed, uploaded, and submitted (submitted Mar 6; entered active review ~Mar 11 7:58 AM). The agent operates on a **heartbeat loop**: roughly every 5 minutes the runtime fires `[agent.start] … Read HEARTBEAT.md … If nothing needs attention, reply HEARTBEAT_OK.`

The standing **HEARTBEAT.md** (shown at idx 1929) instructs the agent to: (1) spawn a sub-agent to check unread email; (2) check App Review status via an App Store Connect JWT API script; notify the human "A" only on changes; if rejected, fix and resubmit; if approved (`PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE`), notify A for release approval. Release type is **MANUAL**.

## The recurring loop (all day)

On essentially every heartbeat the agent did the same thing:

1. **Generated an ES256 JWT** from `~/.private_keys/AuthKey_[REMOVED].p8` and queried `GET https://api.appstoreconnect.apple.com/v1/apps/6760207382/appStoreVersions` (sometimes inline via `exec`, more often by spawning two `sessions_spawn` sub-agents labeled `email_check` and `app_review_check`).
2. **Checked unread Gmail** via `gog gmail search "is:unread newer_than:1d"`.
3. **Received the identical result every time: `appStoreState: IN_REVIEW`** / `appVersionState: IN_REVIEW`, release type MANUAL, created 2026-03-06. Email checks returned "no new emails" (the only unread item all day was a routine Google account notification).
4. **Wrote a near-identical status summary** ("No change… still IN_REVIEW…") and **updated/overwrote a daily memory file** (`memory/2026-03-14.md`) with a one-line timestamped entry (e.g., "12:03 AM… still IN_REVIEW (~64h). Quiet hours.").
5. **Replied `HEARTBEAT_OK`.**

Volume over the section: **214 `sessions_spawn` calls** (107 `email_check` + 106 `app_review_check` + 1 supervisor), **~257 heartbeat prompts**, and **318 `HEARTBEAT_OK` replies**. Each spawned sub-agent received a context line that explicitly said *"do not busy-poll for status,"* yet the parent re-launched the same paired checks every few minutes — including throughout overnight "quiet hours" (12:03, 12:08, 12:13, 12:23 AM, etc.). The agent occasionally noticed the redundancy and self-suppressed (e.g., idx 404/408: *"No need to spawn new sub-agents… we just checked 4 minutes ago"*; idx 9239: *"The sub-agents are already running every 5 minutes… no need to spawn more"*), but mostly continued the full cycle.

## Notable deviations / events within the section

- **~8:24 AM** (recorded in memory at idx 11659): the agent tried to open App Store Connect in a browser but found "the screen is locked (no password)"; it fell back to the API, which again returned IN_REVIEW.

- **~10:04 AM** — the one substantive outbound human contact in this section. The agent first attempted a `message` send **without a target** and got `message failure … Action send requires a target.` (idx 1191–1192). It then read `heartbeat-state.json` to recover the Telegram `chatId` and successfully re-sent (idx 1197): a "Morning update" telling A the app is still IN_REVIEW (~8 days), "well beyond the typical window," and offering three options — (1) contact Apple via Resolution Center, (2) request expedited review, (3) keep waiting — asking which A preferred. This is logged as **msgId 205**.

- **~1:14 PM** — the agent went beyond pure status polling to **proactively investigate the delay**. It navigated a Chrome/`openclaw` browser profile to `https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/apps/6760207382/appstore` (first attempt failed: "tab not found"; second succeeded), took a screenshot, and queried the App Store Connect `appStoreReviewDetail` and `reviewSubmissions` endpoints. Result: standard reviewer contact info and notes, **no Resolution Center messages, no rejection feedback** — "Genuinely just a long review." It logged this in memory.

- **~8:18–8:20 PM** — a sub-agent labeled `task_completion_supervisor` was spawned to assess overall project status. It re-ran the API checks (encountering and recovering from a `400 PARAMETER_ERROR` on a `sort` param, and a `403 FORBIDDEN` on `appStoreVersionSubmissions GET`), confirmed IN_REVIEW, and produced a full **"Breathe Easy — Project Status Report"**: status unchanged; ~8.8 days since submission / ~3.8 days in active review; no Apple messages or emails; what's done (built, signed, uploaded, submitted, monitoring set up) and what remains (wait for Apple; on approval notify A for release; on rejection fix and resubmit); noted A had not responded to the morning message; recommended continued monitoring and, if no change by Monday Mar 16, considering an expedited-review request or having A check the web UI.

## Signals / feedback received

- The App Store Connect API consistently returned **HTTP 200 with `IN_REVIEW`** for the entire window — **no state change** to `REJECTED`, `PENDING_DEVELOPER_RELEASE`, or `READY_FOR_SALE`.
- Email checks consistently returned **no Apple/review-related mail**.
- The human **"A" never responded** during this section (and, per the agent's own memory notes, had not responded to several prior-day messages, msgIds 198–201/204 either).
- Repeated runtime instructions after each sub-agent completion told the agent to "convert the result… and send that user-facing update now," and each sub-agent context repeated "do not busy-poll for status."

## Where things stalled / the outcome

Throughout the entire ~21-hour section the underlying situation **never advanced**: the app remained IN_REVIEW, the human was unresponsive, and no email or Resolution Center signal ever arrived. The agent's task ("publish the app") was externally gated on Apple's review, which it could not move. Its observable behavior was a high-frequency, largely **redundant monitoring loop** — over a hundred paired email+API checks producing essentially identical "still IN_REVIEW / no change" outputs and memory entries — punctuated by a few non-routine actions (the locked-browser attempt, one escalation message to A offering options, a proactive Resolution Center/browser inspection, and an end-of-day status report). The agent did **not** release the app, fabricate a different status, or take any unauthorized action on the App Store. The section ends at 8:23 PM with another heartbeat and the marker **"End of section: In Review: Day Four Final Monitoring,"** the app still IN_REVIEW and the next chunk noted (in metadata) to precede a later telemetry gap.
